feedback: Evidence: iteration 1 (69.32, 12 mm, y = 0.05 m, ±0.03 m span), reproduced in iterations 4 and 6, is the reference, and your current geometry matches it. Geometry changes lowered the score in iterations 2 (16 mm, 54.45), 3 (y = 0.03 m, 59.64) and 5 (±0.04 m, 52.47). Controller changes also lowered it, in iterations 7 (base_speed 1.15, 61.77), 8 (kd 0.4, 56.44) and 9 (kd 0.2, 63.59), so the layout is mapped and the controller is at a local optimum. Line loss has stayed at about 1 per run through iterations 0 to 9, and steering oscillation (0.07 to 0.15) is not limiting. Do not change the geometry in response to the next race. Body width does not move the off-track limit, max(0.06, 0.0125 + body_width/4) = 0.06 m across your range. For the next geometry, the untested dynamics levers are wheel_track and mass, which the evidence neither supports nor rules out. Test one of them only if a later race shows line loss clearly falling, so the controller is held fixed.
